  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "SCALD [1] THE {{ing_01|FLAMINGO}}, WASH AND DRESS IT, PUT IT IN A POT, ADD {{ing_02|WATER}}, {{ing_03|SALT}}, {{ing_04|DILL}}, AND {{ing_05|A LITTLE VINEGAR}}, TO BE PARBOILED."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "FINISH COOKING WITH {{ing_06|A BUNCH OF LEEKS}} AND {{ing_07|CORIANDER}}, AND ADD SOME {{ing_08|REDUCED MUST}} TO GIVE IT COLOR."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "IN THE MORTAR CRUSH {{ing_09|PEPPER}}, {{ing_10|CUMIN}}, {{ing_11|CORIANDER}}, {{ing_12|LASER ROOT}}, {{ing_13|MINT}}, {{ing_14|RUE}}, MOISTEN WITH {{ing_15|VINEGAR}}, ADD {{ing_16|DATES}}, AND THE {{ing_17|FOND OF THE BRAISED BIRD}}, THICKEN, [strain] COVER THE BIRD WITH THE SAUCE AND SERVE."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "PARROT IS PREPARED IN THE SAME MANNER."
    }
